_comment: Input to L1-design-data-architect, DELTA INVOCATION (BOM Phase 4), as distinct from the foundational invocation at Phase 2.25. Per the BOM row: the LLD deltas, functional_requirements, and the CURRENT data-architecture.md. Unlike the HLD and LLD deltas this cycle, the canonical document exists — v1.0 from Cycle 0 — so this is a genuine amendment rather than a creating delta. The foundational invocation decided ownership, classification and planes; this invocation is constrained by those decisions rather than inventing them.

sections_relevant.DAT-1.1: Identity is sole writer of Producer, Buyer, Session, FoodSafetyRegistration. 13 entities, 4 owning contexts.
sections_relevant.DAT-2.2: 4 events registered, all Planned: catalogue.listing.published, orders.order.placed, identity.registration.verified, billing.payout.scheduled
sections_relevant.DAT-3.2: FoodSafetyRegistration — Regulated Evidence, 6 years from creation (ES3), approved PII region (ES9), append-only
sections_relevant.DAT-4.3: Analytical plane NOT PRESENT; three trigger conditions; DAT-PEND-01
sections_relevant.DAT-6: Read models: None at Cycle 0. Any future replicated attribute must be entered here with a staleness budget before use.
sections_relevant.DAT-8: DAT-PEND-01 analytical plane, DAT-PEND-02 order retention, DAT-PEND-03 session retention
sections_relevant.DAT-9: DAT-C1 one writer per entity, DAT-C2 no unregistered replication, DAT-C3 protected data governed

current_canonical_document.boundary_rule: The data architecture states WHAT and WHY. Physical tables, indexes, column types and SQL belong to db-schema.sql and the service LLD — never to this document.

access_patterns.pattern: latest non-superseded FoodSafetyRegistration row per producer, ordered by appended_at

new_stored_values.description: The competent authority's rejection reason string, stored verbatim so it can be passed through unparaphrased

deltas.write_discipline: append-only; ProducerRepository exposes supersede() and no update()

findings.summary: Append-only evidence plus a 250 ms status read implies an index, and possibly a current-status projection.
The register's reason string is a newly stored value on a Regulated Evidence entity and no classification covers it.

content.execution_summary: • 3 creating LLD deltas; 2 findings escalated to the data architect.

functional_requirements.title: Facilitation-only role attestation at onboarding
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall require every onboarding producer or distributor to explicitly attest that they, not HarvestLink, hold Food Business Operator status.

functional_requirements.title: FBO status verification
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall verify a producer's declared Food Business Operator registration against the competent authority's register before permitting that producer to publish a listing.

functional_requirements.title: External-party authentication
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall authenticate external parties through a group-approved external identity provider.

tool-L1-db-schema-diff.reason: Optional per the BOM row and used to diff a proposed schema against an existing production database. Cycle 1 is pre-production for identity-service — there is no deployed schema to diff against, and the application baseline records identity-service as DECLARED with no deployed_version. Running it would compare a proposal against nothing and return a diff that looks like a full creation.
